findings.comment: Required zoning district setback lines (front yard, rear yard, interior side yard, street side yard) are not clearly drawn as continuous boundaries, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan. Individual point-to-point dimensions from buildings to property lines are shown (15.0' to 29.8'), but the required setback boundary lines themselves are not depicted. The Site Data Table on Sheet 9 identifies the zoning as MF-2 but does not specify the required setback distances.

Zoning district setback compliance cannot be verified. While point-to-point dimensions from buildings to property lines are labeled on the site plan (ranging from 15.0' to 29.8'), the required minimum setback distances for the MF-2 zoning district are not shown on the plans. Without the required setback standards displayed, the applicant's compliance with LDC § 25-2-492 cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: property perimeter fences and retaining walls
findings.comment: Fences and retaining walls are shown on the site plan along the property perimeter (wood fence and concrete retaining walls noted on Sheets 9 and 31), but because required zoning setback lines are not drawn on the plans, the relationship between fence locations and building setback lines cannot be verified. Additionally, fence heights are not labeled.

applicableAreas: buildings fronting Valley View Road (west side)
findings.comment: Fire department access setback compliance cannot be verified. Facts.md indicates the Valley View Road right-of-way width is 58 or 64 feet (determination required). Buildings are shown with dimensions from the west property line (26.1' for Building 1, 24.3' for Building 8), but the distance from the street centerline to building faces is not explicitly dimensioned on the plans, preventing verification of the 30-foot minimum setback requirement for streets with less than 60-foot right-of-way.

Transformer pad clearances are not shown or noted. Four electrical transformer pads are located on the site (identified on Sheet 21 north of Building 2, between Buildings 4 and 5, west of Building 8, and south of Building 7), but no clearance zones, radii, standoff distances, or notes regarding Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4 clearance requirements (10 ft, 5 ft, 12 ft, or 15 ft depending on structure type and location) are graphically shown or labeled. Compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: fire hydrant locations near Building 6, Building 7, and outside northwest corner
findings.comment: Fire hydrant obstruction compliance cannot be verified. Fences and retaining walls are shown on the site plan, but fence heights are not labeled on any sheet. The Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows one existing and two proposed fire hydrants, but without labeled fence heights, the potential obstruction of hydrant access by fencing 4 feet or greater in height cannot be assessed.

Zoning variance need cannot be determined. While the site plan shows point-to-point distances from buildings to property lines, the required MF-2 setback standards are not displayed on the plans. Therefore, it cannot be verified whether any standard zoning setback reduction requiring a Board of Adjustment variance has been obtained, or whether such a variance is even necessary.

Letter of non-enforcement requirement cannot be verified. The site is within the recorded Mecey Subdivision (Vol. 73, Page 76, filed December 11, 1975), and platted setback lines may exist that differ from current code requirements. The plat is shown on Sheet 2, but the vision analysis did not identify any platted setback lines that differ from standard code. A review of the plat recorded instrument is needed to determine if a letter of non-enforcement from the City is required.

applicableAreas: wood fences and concrete retaining walls shown on property perimeter
findings.comment: Fence height compliance cannot be verified. Wood fences and concrete retaining walls are depicted on the site plan sheets, but no heights are labeled on any sheet. The fence height limits under LDC § 25-2-899 (6 feet standard, 7 feet where grade change ≥ 1 foot, 8 feet under specific conditions) cannot be verified without labeled fence heights.

applicableAreas: wooden privacy fences shown on site plan
findings.comment: Fence design restriction compliance (post-July 31, 2023) cannot be verified. Wooden privacy fences are labeled on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31, H.6), but detailed specifications regarding picket design, spike prohibition, barbed/razor wire prohibition, and knuckle selvage chain link requirements under LDC § 25-2-899(I) are not provided. Construction type and design details are insufficient to verify compliance.
